mission_08: Outstanding! You have explored robust regression methods that resist the influence of outliers without requiring explicit detection and removal. OLS, as expected, was heavily skewed by outliers, producing biased coefficients. Huber Regression, using its hybrid loss function, provided a compromise that downweights but does not completely ignore outliers. RANSAC, by fitting exclusively to inliers, recovered coefficients closest to the true values. These robust methods are invaluable when outliers are inherent to the data generation process rather than measurement errors. They provide a principled alternative to the detect-and-remove paradigm, especially in automated pipelines where manual inspection is not feasible. Understanding when to use robust methods versus explicit outlier detection is a key skill for any data scientist.
